channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: ESB Networks Crews Depart for Portugal After Devastating Storms Leave 1 Million Without Power
item.description: ESB Networks crews head to Portugal to help restore power to 1 million customers hit by Storms Kristin and Leonardo, departing from Rosslare Port.

item.title: Man Hospitalised After Stabbing Incident on Oliver Plunkett Street
item.description: Man in his 50s hospitalised after sustaining multiple stab wounds on Oliver Plunkett Street today.

item.title: Road Closure on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a road closure due to roadworks, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 10 Mahon and Junction 6 (N27) Kinsale Road (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 6 February at 16:08.

item.title: M28 Cork to Ringaskiddy: Construction Progress Update for 6 February 2026
item.description: M28 progress update: new excavation works underway, lane closure at Carr's Hill coming soon, and Ringaskiddy Relief Road nearing completion.

item.title: Government Launches Public Consultation on Future of Children's Care in Ireland
item.description: Minister Foley launches public consultation on the future of children's care in Ireland, with input invited until late March 2026.

item.title: Cork Author Caroline O'Donoghue Shortlisted for 2026 KPMG Children's Books Ireland Awards
item.description: Cork's Caroline O'Donoghue shortlisted for 2026 KPMG Children's Books Ireland Awards for her novel Skipshock.

item.title: European Commission Says TikTok's Addictive Design Breaches Digital Services Act
item.description: EU Commission says TikTok's addictive design features breach the Digital Services Act, with fines of up to 6% of global turnover possible.

item.title: Road Closures in Lehenaghmore as Major Works Begin
item.description: Pouladuff Road closed for at least two weeks for major pipe works linked to 150+ new affordable homes in Lehenaghmore. Expect delays and follow diversions.

item.title: The Days of the Dodgy Box May Be Numbered as Gardaí Shut Down IPTV Operation
item.description: Gardaí shut down almost 200 illegal IPTV accounts in Galway raid today. If you're using a dodgy box, consider this your warning.

item.title: Road Closures and Traffic Plan for Cork v Tipperary at Páirc Uí Chaoimh Tomorrow
item.description: Road closures from 3pm tomorrow for Cork v Tipperary at Páirc Uí Chaoimh. Up to 30,000 expected. Plan your route and allow extra time.
